heroLine1: Underground, a stable, free and inexhaustible energy
heroSubtitle: Switch to closed-loop geothermal energy with WellDoneDrill and enjoy year-round thermal comfort thanks to stable, local and sustainable energy, tailored to your project in Belgium.
howBody:
The geothermal probe is a U-shaped tube inserted into a vertical borehole 80 to 200 m deep. It provides heat transfer with the ground, which holds a stable temperature of around 10–14 °C all year round.

The heat pump boosts this energy to produce hot water at 35–55 °C, supplying the heating (underfloor heating or low-temperature radiators) and domestic hot water. In summer the cycle reverses: the building's heat is dissipated into the ground, providing natural cooling with no significant extra consumption.

introBody1: Closed-loop geothermal relies on vertical boreholes installed underground. They capture the heat naturally stored in the ground and transfer it to a heat pump to heat the building in winter and cool it in summer.
introBody2: It is a lean, discreet and robust solution, suited to single homes as well as larger buildings, with a small ground footprint and very stable performance.
